observation.observationWindow: unknown; the source file records one timestamp for the whole scan

provenance.source: an automated browser scan written by this project's author; that scanner is not in this repository
provenance.observationWindow: unknown; the source file records one timestamp for the whole scan
provenance.reobserve: this command re-renders the recorded file; re-observing these points needs your own provider
provenance.note: ranks are the order of the Google Maps results feed as seen by a logged-out desktop browser at zoom 13; a Places API re-scan measures a different surface and may differ
provenance.rankSource: position of the target place id in each point's captured list
provenance.directNote: brand search landed on a place page; the single landed listing is the result list

redaction.ids: hashed: h: plus the first 16 hex characters of SHA-256(salt + id), with a per-study salt that is not published
redaction.centre: rounded to 2 decimal places, about 1 km
redaction.points: recomputed from the rounded centre with the recorded pins, so the geometry still replays
redaction.observedAt: the scan was observed at the true coordinates; the published ones are the rounded centre and its replanned points
redaction.warning: Withheld is not anonymous: the town, the query and the date are kept, and they narrow the candidates a long way.
redaction.reason: business names withheld and ids hashed for publication; the town, the query, the date and the ring geometry are kept so the scan can be recomputed
